messages.text:
Hi! I'm interested in buying the Hammer Miner Thor X1 (3.2 TH/s, 46W), but I noticed that the power supply is not included.

Could you please tell me the exact power supply specifications required for this miner?
- Required voltage and amperage
- Required USB-C power rating (watts)
- Whether it requires USB-C Power Delivery (PD)
- Whether you sell a compatible power supply, and if so, how much it costs

I want to make sure I buy a compatible and safe power supply before ordering.

Thank you!
Read the hammer miner thor x1 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor X1 power supply USB-C
Handed to the team · Listing only states "NO POWERSUPPLY (needs usb-c)" — no PD profile, voltage/ampe

Good question to ask before buying rather than after.

What the X1 listing states is this: it ships with no power supply and needs USB-C, 3.2 TH/s at about 46 W at the wall, $219. What it doesn't publish is the exact PD profile — the voltage/amperage it negotiates and the minimum charger wattage. I won't guess that for you, because the wrong guess is exactly the unsafe buy you're trying to avoid.

I've put it to JD on our hardware side for the exact figure; he'll come into this chat, and you'll get it by email if you step away. We don't sell a USB-C brick for it — our Power Kit is an energy monitor plus an AC cable, not a charger.

One thing worth knowing while you wait: the Hammer BC04 is $249, 6 TH/s at ~100 W, and comes with its own 120 W power supply and cord. Nearly double the hashrate for $30 more and nothing else to source. Want me to put that side by side with the X1 at your power rate?

Hi! I have a few questions about the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s):

1. The B.04 is currently sold out. Do you know when it will be back in stock?
2. I’m shipping to Israel. Does the $30 shipping fee include all customs duties and import taxes (DDP), or will I need to pay anything extra when the package arrives?
3. Is the power supply and power cable included in the $249 price?

Thank you!
Read the hammer miner bc04 page
Handed to the team · BC04 shows available in the catalog but reads sold out for the shopper's region;

Taking those in order.

Three: yes. The B.04 at $249 includes the 120 W power supply and the power cord — nothing else to buy. That's the difference from the X1 you were looking at.

Two: no, it's not DDP. Our shipping charge covers carriage only. Israeli VAT and any customs duty are raised on delivery by the carrier or customs and are the recipient's responsibility — we don't collect them at checkout and I can't quote what your customs office will assess.

One: the BC04 itself is live and in stock in our catalog, so the sold-out you're seeing is a regional one — our BC04 stock sits in the US, Canada and EU warehouses, and the plug variants are locked by destination. I can't confirm Israel from here, so I've put it to Georges to tell you whether we can ship one there and with which plug. He'll come into this chat; stay here if you can, otherwise it comes by email.
Do you already have my email address for this support conversation, or do I need to provide it so Georges can contact me if I leave the chat?
I don't have it — nothing in this chat has your email attached. Drop it here and it goes on the case with both questions, so Georges and JD can reach you if you step away.
Got it — (email hidden) is on the case now, with both open questions: the Thor X1's USB-C power spec for JD, and the BC04 to Israel for Georges. If you step away, the answers come to that address.
